## Exact-head merge contract

- [ ] I reviewed every PR comment/thread against the current head.
- [ ] Every actionable finding has code/tests or an explicit resolution.
- [ ] Addressed review threads are resolved.
- [ ] Exact-head tests, fuzz/fork suites, gas/CU checks and budgets are green.
- [ ] I will not merge while CI is red/pending or actionable review feedback remains.
- [ ] I will merge only the SHA validated by the gate.
- [ ] I will verify the fresh `main` workflow after merge.

## Benchmark impact

Describe any state-size, compute-unit, account-count, transaction-size, or quote-performance change.
